notes.title: Seaburn Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just released patch 1.0.3, addressing bugs and adding more content. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Added animation for opening or creating a save file
[*]Added more content for the social media system
[*]Fixed issue where the same legislation can be encountered twice within a short amount of time
[*]Fixed minor spelling issues
[*]Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
If you think you have a cool feature you'd like us to add, or if you found a bug with our game, feel free to reach out at treeburnstudios@athenas.dev or DM us on Instagram at @tree.burn.

notes.title: Seaburn Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Patch 1.0.2 has arrived! In this patch, we have fixed many bugs and added some features. 
[list]
[*]Minor balancing changes
[*]Minor aesthetic changes
[*]Improved back buttons
[*]Removed pause menu in certain scenes
[*]Added indicator for when there are no events in the current week
[*]Fixed bug where event options could be clicked too early
[*]Fixed bug where the election counter would be displayed abnormally during week 1
[*]Fixed bug where the tooltip would behave abnormally on first launch
[/list]
If you think you have a cool feature you'd like us to add, or if you found a bug with our game, feel free to reach out at [i]treeburnstudios@athenas.dev[/i] or DM us on Instagram at [url=https://instagram.com/tree.burn]@tree.burn[/url].

notes.title: Seaburn is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Seaburn is now available! 

We acknowledge that as a group of high school students, this game may not be completely perfect and bug-free. However, over the next couple of weeks and months we will be releasing a series of patches to address bugs and add more features. If you think you have a cool feature you'd like us to add, or if you found a bug with our game, feel free to reach out at [i]treeburnstudios@athenas.dev[/i] or DM us on Instagram at [url=https://instagram.com/tree.burn]@tree.burn[/url]. 

If you have enjoyed our game, please write a review if possible! It would really mean a lot to us to have the game reach more potential players, educating them in ocean literacy.

On behalf of Treeburn Studios, we'd also like to thank the following people/organizations who made this project possible:
[list]
[*]Stephen Knightly from RocketWerkz, who provided us with expert game development feedback
[*]Nikki Kaye, co-founder of Blue Nature Aotearoa, who provided us with feedback on political aspects
[*]The Royal New Zealand Yacht Squadron, for providing us with a space to work out of every Wednesday
[*]Albany Senior High School, for funding us and making this Impact Project possible in the first place
[*]And all our amazing teachers, beta testers, players, and countless internet strangers who helped us debug, solve problems, and improve the game
[/list]

notes.title: Seaburn will be releasing next Wednesday!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Seaburn will be releasing globally next Wednesday at 12:00 AM NZST (Tuesday 12:00 PM UTC). 

We can't wait for you to enjoy our game and learn more about ocean-related issues! 

[h3]Some tips before you get started:[/h3][list]
[*]Click on the stack of papers on your desk to approve legislations, which will have an effect on the environment and your public opinion
[*]Click on the corkboard when there is a red exclamation mark to respond to optional events
[*]Click on the door to progress the game
[/list]
